card.name: Prolonged and similar words in drug labels
card.fires_on: The word "prolonged" (also "delayed") after words like significantly, slightly or following, in drug-effect text. Also the middle of long medical terms such as hematological or polymorphic.

modes.label: Prolonged / delayed
modes.description: "Prolonged" or "delayed" describing longer duration or half-life, often after an adverb.
modes.example: Ritonavir significantly<< prolonged>> the half-life of vardenafil to

modes.label: Inside medical terms
modes.description: The ending part of long clinical adjectives such as hematological or polymorphic.

card.plain: It marks words like "prolonged" that say an effect or half-life lasts longer, and some endings of long medical terms.
